findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
The hand sink was observed blocked with bottles. The hand sink must be maintained accessible a all times. The bottles were moved during the inspection to correct the violation. 

5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions.

findings.title: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used
findings.comment:
7-102.11: Observed a container that was labeled bleach but had an alcohol solution in it. Ensure containers are properly labeled. The container was dumped out to correct the violation. 
Working containers used for storing POISONOUS OR TOXIC MATERIALS such as cleaners and SANITIZERS taken from bulk supplies shall be clearly and individually identified with the common name of the material.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
No bleach test strips available in facility.  Provide test strips as soon as possible.

750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: Observed chlorine in the facility and no test strips for bleach. provide proper chlorine test strips. 750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: Observed utensils in the drawer which are stored in a divider that is soiled with food splash. Clean divider regularly so that it does not potentially contaminate the clean utensils. 750-860 Cleaned and sanitized utensils an equipment shall be stored at least six inches above the floor in a clean, dry location in a way that protects them from contamination by splash, dust and other means.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: There is a hole in the floor at the back corner behind the mop sink. A pipe and hose are fed through the hole. Seal the hole. 750-1200 All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment:
Date mark milk with the date gallon is opened. Milk was date marked during the inspection.
750-151(a) Refrigerated potentially hazardous ready to eat food held at the establishment more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked with the date or day by which the food shall be consumed, sold, or discarded. Maximum holding time at 41°F is 7 days. Properly date mark food and do not hold longer than 7 days.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment:
Label all personal foods or label a designated area in the cooler rather than having personal foods interspersed with food for the children as it was at the time of the inspection. 
750-100 Food shall be obtained from sources that comply with all laws relating to food and food labeling.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.comment: Make sure all personal foods are labeled in fridge and stored below foods for kids.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment: Leak at the three compartment sink. Repair leak.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: No paper towels at hand sink in kitchen. Provide paper towels.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.comment: No light in the refrigerator. Replace light and make sure it is shielded or shatterproof.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.citation_text: 750.1290 Observed unapproved hand sanitizer at kitchen hand sink. Sanitizer was removed during inspection and use of hand sanitizer in food service was discussed as this does not replace handwashing.

findings.title: Original container, properly labeled, consumer advisory
findings.citation_text: 750.130 Personal foods in cooler were not labeled. Label all personal foods and do not serve to children.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: 750.1120e. No hand soap was available at the hand sink. Soap was provided during inspection.

findings.title: Lighting provided as required.  Fixtures shielded
findings.citation_text: 750.1240 a. Light shield in kitchen missing. Light shield needs to be replaced.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment: CORRECTED> Observed a chemical spray bottle to not be labeled properly with the name of its contents. Bottle was labeled. 750.1300 Containers of toxic materials must be distinctly labeled.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
CORRECTED > Observed eggs being stored above ready to eat food in the refrigerator. Eggs were moved to the bottom shelve away from ready to eat foods.
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed the interior cabinet ceiling of the microwave to be soiled with food debris. Wash, rinse, and sanitize the interior cabinet of the microwave.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
CORRECTED > No soap was observed at the kitchen hand sink. Soap was moved to hand sink.
750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.

findings.title: Outer openings protected from insects, rodent proof
findings.comment:
CORRECTED > Observed the back door next to the kitchen propped open when inspection started. Door was closed during inspection.
750-1170 Openings to the outside shall be protected against the entrance of rodents and insects.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 880: Wrapped single-service observed being stored on the floor in the toilet room. Properly stored items off the floor in designated cabinets. During inspection, items stored outside of toilet room - above the handsink.

findings.title: Potential for cross-contamination; storage practices; damaged food segregated
findings.comment:
750-130(d)  All raw meat shall be properly stored, store in the order of their cooking requirements with the lowest temperatures on the top shelf and the highest required temperature product on the bottom. Watch the storage of your personal raw ground beef. 
750-160  There was observed chemicals and paints stored above infant formula, infant foods and other infant service utensils. Food shall be protected at all times from cross-contamination. During the inspection, these items were stored away from the handsink and chemical storage shelves.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.comment: 750-130(b) About four boxes of chips, cereals etc. were observed stored on the floor of the facility. Keep food stored off the floor to prevent nuisance attraction and allow for proper cleaning. There is room on the walls for additional storage if necessary. During the inspection, the food was placed on the shelves boxes were stored beneath. Food shall be stored at least 6 inches off the floor.  Properly store and protect food.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: 750-600 The shelf above the handsink was storing infant formula and container red foam non-stick padding. The shelf beneath the padding is soiled. During the inspection, the foam padding was removed. Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable

findings.title: Storage/handling of clean equipment, utensils
findings.comment: 750-850 Child plates and bowls are observed being stored on a top shelf, not inverted, not properly covered. Cleaned and sanitized equipment and utensils shall be handled in a way that protects them from contamination.  Plates shall be stored inverted or covered.

findings.title: Single service items properly stored, handled, dispensed
findings.comment: 750-880 Brand new single service containers, spoons, bowls etc are being stored within a clean mop sink. Mop sink is almost unnecessary b/c of the large area rug in the kitchen. Single-service articles shall be handled and dispensed in a manner which prevents contamination of surfaces which may come in contact with food or with the mouth of the user.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.comment: 750-1200 There is a large area rug being used in the kitchen. Surface is not smooth and easily cleanable. Remove the rug from the kitchen to allow for proper cleaning of the floor. All floors must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean floors.

findings.title: Premises maintained fee of litter, unnecessary articles. Cleaning and maintaining equipment properly...
findings.comment: 750-1350c The cabinet beneath the handsink has a variety of items being stored. The storage of food and equipment beneath drainlines is forbidden. The articles observed under the sink are primarily personal (not a concern), chemicals (not a concern) and unused equipment. Remove these old straws, ice cube trays, and bottles from the facility. IF you should wish to store any equipment beneath the handsink apply for a variance.   Only articles necessary for the operation and maintenance of the food service establishment shall be stored on the premises.  Remove all unnecessary items.
